description: Initial follow-up definitions. Stable IDs must never be reused. Status comes from append-only database events, not this seed file.

priority_policy.high: Blocks trusted identity, coverage or geometry interpretation.
priority_policy.medium: Source qualification or follow-up needed before the dependent use.

findings.title: Source presence gaps
findings.description: Neither parcel source reports records under 141 reference codes. Code conflicts mean this is not proof of absent data.
findings.next_action: Investigate each absent reference code and municipal publication routes before claiming coverage.

findings.title: Sweden code/name conflict
findings.description: 691 organized records named Sweden report Stow code 17290; identifier prefixes support 17310.
findings.next_action: Corroborate with municipal/source geometry evidence; record an explicit correction crosswalk without altering raw data.

findings.title: Alfred code/name conflict
findings.description: 1,634 records named Alfred report Arundel code 31030; identifier prefixes do not corroborate Alfred.
findings.next_action: Determine whether name, code or both are wrong using independent municipal evidence.

findings.title: Other jurisdiction-name discrepancies
findings.description: Blank names, misspellings and Plantation/Plt variants remain explicit differences.
findings.next_action: Review each difference and document accepted aliases separately from source values.

findings.title: Unrecognized jurisdiction codes
findings.description: UT codes 59793 and 65185 are absent from the reference; affected records remain unassigned.
findings.next_action: Trace publisher identifiers and geometry location before proposing jurisdiction matches.

findings.title: Blank jurisdiction identifiers
findings.description: Four UT and fourteen organized source rows lack jurisdiction codes.
findings.next_action: Locate affected source records and collect independent assignment evidence.

findings.title: Missing candidate parcel identifiers
findings.description: Candidate identifiers are missing in UT geometry, organized geometry and assessment sources.
findings.next_action: Preserve source row identity and investigate identifiers without dropping unmatched rows.

findings.title: Repeated and placeholder identifiers
findings.description: TPL/GPL/STATE_ID repeat; placeholders and one-to-many source representations need interpretation.
findings.next_action: Classify repeated-key groups and test candidate compound keys before canonical matching.

findings.title: Assessment records unmatched by identifier
findings.description: 143 keys in the audit sample had no assessment match. Missing matches are not proof of absent assessments.
findings.next_action: Investigate unmatched keys and alternate municipal feeds; retain the exact matching scope.

findings.title: Assessment relationship multiplicity
findings.description: The declared one-to-one relationship fails for eleven sampled keys.
findings.next_action: Review all candidate rows and distinguish assessment units, geometry parts and faulty identifiers.

findings.title: Missing source dates
findings.description: Many records lack FMUPDAT or MAPYEAR values.
findings.next_action: Seek dated municipal deliveries or provenance; keep retrieval time distinct from source currency.

findings.title: Malformed or uninterpreted source dates
findings.description: Zero/short values cannot be interpreted as reliable dates.
findings.next_action: Resolve date meanings with publisher evidence; retain original values and precision.

findings.title: Jurisdiction legal-effective dates unknown
findings.description: The dated GEOCODES reference does not establish current legal status for each jurisdiction.
findings.next_action: Establish effective dates and authority for jurisdiction changes before regulatory conclusions.

findings.title: Source record identifier stability untested
findings.description: GlobalID is unique in the audit, but stability across refreshes and legal-identity meaning remain untested.
findings.next_action: Compare successive source deliveries; retain source/version/OID alongside GlobalID.

findings.title: Compound-key uniqueness untested
findings.description: A multi-field distinct query was rejected; map/lot composite uniqueness is unresolved.
findings.next_action: Profile composite keys from preserved source records without lossy normalization.

findings.title: UT valuation-book linkage untested
findings.description: Valuation PDFs have not been validated as a structured source or joined to GIS identifiers.
findings.next_action: Inspect a bounded valuation book and map/lot index; document extraction and join evidence.

findings.title: Source rights and reuse limits unresolved
findings.description: Public endpoint access alone does not establish redistribution or bulk-use rights.
findings.next_action: Record publisher terms and attribution requirements for each source before broader distribution.

findings.title: Parcel-source overlap unresolved
findings.description: Five jurisdiction codes occur in both parcel products; parcel-level overlap is unmeasured.
findings.next_action: Compare source geometries and identifiers; preserve distinct source records until matching evidence supports a crosswalk.

findings.title: Assessment YEAR_CREAT semantics unresolved
findings.description: The date field has diverse values and a truncated per-jurisdiction profile was excluded.
findings.next_action: Confirm field meaning, then profile all values with complete pagination.

findings.title: Full assessment join coverage unmeasured
findings.description: The 321-key geographic sample is not a statewide match rate.
findings.next_action: Measure full-source join cardinality after reliable source ingestion and key profiling.

findings.title: Jurisdiction parcel completeness unknown
findings.description: Observed source presence does not establish complete legal-parcel coverage.
findings.next_action: Reconcile jurisdiction deliveries against authoritative dated inventories and omissions.

findings.title: Geometry quality and boundary authority unresolved
findings.description: Valid GIS geometry does not establish legal boundary confidence; invalid/missing/undecodable geometry needs review.
findings.next_action: Review geometry defects without silent repair; obtain separate boundary evidence for boundary-sensitive conclusions.

findings.title: Assessment candidate jurisdiction disagreement
findings.description: One sampled one-to-one identifier match disagrees on GEOCODE.
findings.next_action: Investigate candidate code disagreements before treating identifiers as trusted links.

findings.title: Conserved Lands: source qualification
findings.description: PUB_ACCESS exists but actual permissions need confirmation.; Approximate ownership/easement geometries.
findings.next_action: Validate CL_UNIQUEID, rights fields and tax-map linkage; preserve inventory limitations.

findings.title: Tree Growth/current-use tax status: source qualification
findings.description: GIS or listing statements cannot establish enrollment, withdrawals or obligations.
findings.next_action: Identify publisher and access terms, then profile coverage and dates before implementation.

findings.title: Deeds, recorded plans and easements: source qualification
findings.description: A retrieved deed does not establish a complete title chain or resolve boundary/access disputes.
findings.next_action: Record each registry's index, image/plan access, terms and costs; test document identifiers before automation.

findings.title: 3DEP elevation product catalog: source qualification
findings.description: Bounding-box matches do not prove full state coverage.; Resolution, vertical units/datum and acquisition date must be retained.
findings.next_action: Build Maine-intersecting tile inventory; inspect raster metadata, overlap and gaps before slope/aspect derivation.

findings.title: NFHL availability index: source qualification
findings.description: This probe tested an availability index, not the flood-hazard polygon layer.; No returned hazard must not be interpreted as no flood risk without coverage evidence.
findings.next_action: Identify hazard layer in official service; compare study coverage and effective map dates before overlay.

findings.title: 3DHP and legacy NHD: source qualification
findings.description: Do not treat legacy NHD as continually updated.; CONUS product presence does not establish local update quality, stream permanence or recreation rights.
findings.next_action: Choose appropriate distribution; inspect Maine coverage, feature identifiers, lineage and version.

findings.title: Land cover and imagery for privacy/remoteness: source qualification
findings.description: Coverage, capture date, resolution and permitted reuse need investigation.
findings.next_action: Identify publisher and access terms, then profile coverage and dates before implementation.

findings.title: Listing and market records: source qualification
findings.description: No provider, license or ingestion route has been selected.
findings.next_action: Identify publisher and access terms, then profile coverage and dates before implementation.

findings.title: LUPC zoning polygons and official maps: source qualification
findings.description: All-Yes flags do not verify legal currency.; Official maps remain necessary for zoning confirmation.; Rights and publication semantics need review.
findings.next_action: Determine authoritative current-zone selection and map-date reconciliation.

findings.title: Municipal zoning and shoreland records: source qualification
findings.description: LUPC coverage cannot stand in for municipal zoning.
findings.next_action: Inventory municipal publication routes and effective dates by jurisdiction; link maps to ordinances.

findings.title: MaineDOT public road centerlines: source qualification
findings.description: Fields such as jurisdictn, surface and traffic require code definitions.; Geometry does not prove deeded access, maintenance obligation or seasonal passability.
findings.next_action: Read data dictionary and dates; validate identifiers and private-road gaps.

findings.title: Wastewater permits and site evaluation: source qualification
findings.description: Mapped soils do not establish site approval.
findings.next_action: Identify permit retrieval paths and parcel-linking fields; define which unknowns require a site evaluator.

findings.title: SSURGO / Soil Data Access: source qualification
findings.description: Soil map units do not establish site-specific septic suitability.; Retain map-unit/component/horizon relationships and units.
findings.next_action: Retrieve one survey-area metadata/package manifest; measure NOTCOM and spatial coverage; validate joins.

findings.title: Building footprint candidate: source qualification
findings.description: OpenStreetMap origin means state hosting does not make every building authoritative.
findings.next_action: Measure building omission and snapshot age before any privacy/remoteness metric.

findings.title: ATV and snowmobile route information: source qualification
findings.description: Trail proximity and permission are different findings.
findings.next_action: Inventory reusable route sources, permitted uses, seasonal dates and permission records.

findings.title: Power, communications and water options: source qualification
findings.description: Network proximity does not establish serviceability or connection cost.
findings.next_action: Identify publisher and access terms, then profile coverage and dates before implementation.

findings.title: National Wetlands Inventory: source qualification
findings.description: Mapping age varies by project.; Screening inventory; no parcel-specific wetland delineation established.
findings.next_action: Select Maine package, preserve project metadata, validate coverage and feature identifiers.
